question: Bhagat singh and B.K. Dutt threw bomb in the central Legislative Assembly on _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**8 April 1929**__.

__
 
• On 8 April 1929__, Bhagat Singh and B. K. Dutt threw a bomb in the Central Legislative Assembly.
